tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check real-time .co.za (R99/yr ZA) and .com ($14/yr US) domain availability and smart alternatives with instant CodeWays One live preview links.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Query live ZARC (.co.za, .org.za, .net.za, .web.za) and global ICANN (.com, .co, .org, .net, .io, .ai) WHOIS, Registrar details, expiry dates, DNS/MX/SPF/DMARC security, and registrar-specific transfer steps.

tools.name: start_website_preview
tools.description: Prepare a CodeWays One live website preview link so a business can search Google Maps or enter details manually to inspect their finished multi-page website in 5 to 10 minutes for R0 / $0 upfront (R250/pm ZA | $39/mo US when live).

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List CodeWays One preview-first plans (R250/pm ZA | $39/mo US), domain registration (R99/yr | $14/yr), and Done-For-You WaaS packages with regional pricing.

tools.name: check_delivery_timeline
tools.description: Check turnaround guarantees for CodeWays One (5 to 10 minute live preview before committing) and Done-For-You WaaS (48h draft delivery) with zero setup fees.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search CodeWays published SEO, AEO, domain registration, business email, and edge architecture guides across South Africa and global markets.

tools.name: get_agency_metrics
tools.description: Get real-time verified CodeWays production metrics (engineering commits, published guides, uptime SLA, and client revenue impact).

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.description: Prepare a pre-filled Done-For-You project intake brief link for the CodeWays engineering team (48h draft turnaround, $0 / R0 setup fee).

tools.name: check_site_readiness
tools.description: Evaluate a prospective website domain for AI readiness, MCP server discovery, mobile responsiveness, and SEO crawl signals.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_articles · Public sink: search_articles, submit_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_articles · Public sink: search_articles, submit_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
